06

AI Workflow

AstroPersonal boardStatus: Backlog

AI Workflow Dashboard is a web app for planning, running, reviewing, and monitoring AI-assisted tasks in one place. It tracks jobs, prompts, agents, outputs, human review, and usage metrics so you can manage AI work like a proper production workflow rather than a pile of scripts.

07

Portfolio Engine

AstroPersonal boardNo status

Portfolio engine is a multi-repo system that powers Ryan Laird’s personal website, CV, project documentation, developer experiments, and API-driven content delivery. The engine is designed so each repo has a clear role, while all repos share the same data model, design language, and workflow.
